name: Document
description: Represents a document. The Document object is a member of the Documents collection. The Documents collection contains all the Document objects that are currently open in Word.
remarks: Use Documents (_index_), where _index_ is the document name or index number, to return a single Document object. The following example closes the document named Report.doc without saving changes. The index number represents the position of the document in the Documents collection. The following example activates the first document in the Documents collection. Use the ActiveDocument property to refer to the document with the focus. The following example uses the Activate method to activate the document named Document 1. The example also sets the page orientation to landscape mode and then prints the document.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns the name of the specified object. Read-only String.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified Document object.

properties.name: BuiltInDocumentProperties
properties.description: Returns a DocumentProperties collection that represents all the built-in document properties for the specified document.

properties.name: CustomDocumentProperties
properties.description: Returns a DocumentProperties collection that represents all the custom document properties for the specified document.

properties.name: Path
properties.description: Returns the disk or Web path to the document. Read-only String.

properties.name: Bookmarks
properties.description: Returns a Bookmarks collection that represents all the bookmarks in a document. Read-only.

properties.name: Tables
properties.description: Returns a Table collection that represents all the tables in the specified document. Read-only.

properties.name: Footnotes
properties.description: Returns a Footnotes collection that represents all the footnotes in a document. Read-only.

properties.name: Endnotes
properties.description: Returns an Endnotes collection that represents all the endnotes in a document. Read-only.

properties.name: Comments
properties.description: Returns a Comments collection that represents all the comments in the specified document. Read-only.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns the document type (template or document). Read-only WdDocumentType.

properties.name: AutoHyphenation
properties.description: True if automatic hyphenation is turned on for the specified document. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: HyphenateCaps
properties.description: True if words in all capital letters can be hyphenated. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: HyphenationZone
properties.description: Returns or sets the width of the hyphenation zone, in points. Read/write Long.

properties.name: ConsecutiveHyphensLimit
properties.description: Returns or sets the maximum number of consecutive lines that can end with hyphens. Read/write. Long.

properties.name: Sections
properties.description: Returns a Section collection that represents the sections in the specified document. Read-only.

properties.name: Paragraphs
properties.description: Returns a Paragraphs collection that represents all the paragraphs in the specified document. Read-only.

properties.name: Words
properties.description: Returns a Words collection that represents all the words in a document. Read-only.

properties.name: Sentences
properties.description: Returns a Sentences collection that represents all the sentences in the document. Read-only.

properties.name: Characters
properties.description: Returns a Characters collection that represents the characters in a document. Read-only.

properties.name: Fields
properties.description: Returns a Fields collection that represents all the fields in the document. Read-only.

properties.name: FormFields
properties.description: Returns a FormFields collection that represents all the form fields in the document. Read-only.

properties.name: Styles
properties.description: Returns a Styles collection for the specified document. Read-only.

properties.name: Frames
properties.description: Returns a Frames collection that represents all the frames in a document. Read-only.

properties.name: TablesOfFigures
properties.description: Returns a TablesOfFigures collection that represents the tables of figures in the specified document. Read-only.

properties.name: Variables
properties.description: Returns a Variables collection that represents the variables stored in the specified document. Read-only.

properties.name: MailMerge
properties.description: Returns a MailMerge object that represents the mail merge functionality for the specified document. Read-only.

properties.name: Envelope
properties.description: Returns an Envelope object that represents an envelope and envelope features in a document. Read-only.

properties.name: FullName
properties.description: Returns a String that represents the name of a document, including the path. Read-only.

properties.name: Revisions
properties.description: Returns a Revisions collection that represents the tracked changes in the document or range. Read-only.

properties.name: TablesOfContents
properties.description: Returns a TablesOfContents collection that represents the tables of contents in the specified document. Read-only.

properties.name: TablesOfAuthorities
properties.description: Returns a TableOfAuthorities collection that represents the tables of authorities in the specified document. Read-only.

properties.name: PageSetup
properties.description: Returns a PageSetup object that is associated with the specified document.

properties.name: Windows
properties.description: Returns a Windows collection that represents all windows for the specified document. Read-only.

properties.name: TablesOfAuthoritiesCategories
properties.description: Returns a TablesOfAuthoritiesCategories collection that represents the available table of authorities categories for the specified document. Read-only.

properties.name: Indexes
properties.description: Returns an Indexes collection that represents all the indexes in the specified document. Read-only.

properties.name: Saved
properties.description: True if the specified document or template has not changed since it was last saved. False if Microsoft Word displays a prompt to save changes when the document is closed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Content
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the main document story. Read-only.

properties.name: ActiveWindow
properties.description: Returns a Window object that represents the active window (the window with the focus). Read-only.

properties.name: Kind
properties.description: Returns or sets the format type that Microsoft Word uses when automatically formatting the specified document. Read/write WdDocumentKind.

properties.name: ReadOnly
properties.description: True if changes to the document cannot be saved to the original document. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: Subdocuments
properties.description: Returns a Subdocuments collection that represents all the subdocuments in the specified document. Read-only.

properties.name: IsMasterDocument
properties.description: True if the specified document is a master document. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: DefaultTabStop
properties.description: Returns or sets the interval (in points) between the default tab stops in the specified document. Read/write Single.

properties.name: EmbedTrueTypeFonts
properties.description: True if Microsoft Word embeds TrueType fonts in a document when it is saved. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: SaveFormsData
properties.description: True if Microsoft Word saves the data entered in a form as a tab-delimited record for use in a database. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ReadOnlyRecommended
properties.description: True if Microsoft Word displays a message box whenever a user opens the document, suggesting that it be opened as read-only. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: SaveSubsetFonts
properties.description: True if Microsoft Word saves a subset of the embedded TrueType fonts with the document. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Compatibility
properties.description: True if the compatibility option specified by the Type argument is enabled. Compatibility options affect how a document is displayed in Microsoft Word. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: StoryRanges
properties.description: Returns a StoryRanges collection that represents all the stories in the specified document. Read-only.

properties.name: CommandBars
properties.description: Returns a CommandBars collection that represents the menu bar and all the toolbars in Microsoft Word.

properties.name: IsSubdocument
properties.description: True if the specified document is a subdocument of a master document. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: SaveFormat
properties.description: Returns the file format of the specified document or file converter. Read-only Long.

properties.name: ProtectionType
properties.description: Returns the protection type for the specified document. Can be one of the following WdProtectionType constants: wdAllowOnlyComments, wdAllowOnlyFormFields, wdAllowOnlyReading, wdAllowOnlyRevisions, or wdNoProtection.

properties.name: Hyperlinks
properties.description: Returns a Hyperlinks collection that represents all the hyperlinks in the specified document. Read-only.

properties.name: Shapes
properties.description: Returns a Shapes collection that represents all the Shape objects in the specified document. Read-only.

properties.name: ListTemplates
properties.description: Returns a ListTemplates collection that represents all the list formats for the specified document. Read-only.

properties.name: Lists
properties.description: Returns a Lists collection that contains all the formatted lists in the specified document. Read-only.

properties.name: UpdateStylesOnOpen
properties.description: True if the styles in the specified document are updated to match the styles in the attached template each time the document is opened. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: AttachedTemplate
properties.description: Returns a Template object that represents the template attached to the specified document. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: InlineShapes
properties.description: Returns an InlineShapes collection that represents all the InlineShape objects in a document. Read-only.

properties.name: Background
properties.description: Returns a Shape object that represents the background image for the specified document. Read-only.

properties.name: GrammarChecked
properties.description: True if a grammar check has been run on the specified range or document. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: SpellingChecked
properties.description: True if spelling has been checked throughout the specified range or document. False if all or some of the range or document has not been checked for spelling. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ShowGrammaticalErrors
properties.description: True if grammatical errors are marked by a wavy green line in the specified document. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ShowSpellingErrors
properties.description: True if Microsoft Word underlines spelling errors in the document. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: PrintPostScriptOverText
properties.description: True if PRINT field instructions (such as PostScript commands) in a document are to be printed on top of text and graphics when a PostScript printer is used. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Container
properties.description: Returns the object that represents the container application for the specified document. Read-only Object.

properties.name: PrintFormsData
properties.description: True if Microsoft Word prints onto a preprinted form only the data entered in the corresponding online form. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ListParagraphs
properties.description: Returns a ListParagraphs object that represents all the numbered paragraphs in a document. Read-only.

properties.name: Password
properties.description: Sets a password that must be supplied to open the specified document. Write-only String.

properties.name: WritePassword
properties.description: Sets a password for saving changes to the specified document. Write-only String.

properties.name: HasPassword
properties.description: True if a password is required to open the specified document. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: WriteReserved
properties.description: True if the specified document is protected with a write password. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: ActiveWritingStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets the writing style for a specified language in the specified document. Read/write String.

properties.name: UserControl
properties.description: True if the document was created or opened by the user. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ReadabilityStatistics
properties.description: Returns a ReadabilityStatistics collection that represents the readability statistics for the specified document or range. Read-only.

properties.name: GrammaticalErrors
properties.description: Returns a ProofreadingErrors collection that represents the sentences that failed the grammar check in the specified document. Read-only.

properties.name: SpellingErrors
properties.description: Returns a ProofreadingErrors collection that represents the words identified as spelling errors in the specified document or range. Read-only.

properties.name: VBProject
properties.description: Returns the VBProject object for the specified template or document.

properties.name: FormsDesign
properties.description: True if the specified document is in form design mode. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: CodeName
properties.description: Returns the code name for the specified document. Read-only String.

properties.name: SnapToGrid
properties.description: True if AutoShapes or East Asian characters are automatically aligned with an invisible grid when they are drawn, moved, or resized in the specified document. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: SnapToShapes
properties.description: True if Microsoft Word automatically aligns AutoShapes or East Asian characters with invisible gridlines that go through the vertical and horizontal edges of other AutoShapes or East Asian characters in the specified document. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: GridDistanceHorizontal
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the amount of horizontal space between the invisible gridlines that Microsoft Word uses when you draw, move, and resize AutoShapes or East Asian characters in the specified document. Read/write.

properties.name: GridDistanceVertical
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the amount of vertical space between the invisible gridlines that Microsoft Word uses when you draw, move, and resize AutoShapes or East Asian characters in the specified document. Read/write.

properties.name: GridOriginHorizontal
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the point, relative to the left edge of the page, where you want the invisible grid for drawing, moving, and resizing AutoShapes or East Asian characters to begin in the specified document. Read/write.

properties.name: GridOriginVertical
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the point, relative to the top of the page, where you want the invisible grid for drawing, moving, and resizing AutoShapes or East Asian characters to begin in the specified document. Read/write.

properties.name: GridSpaceBetweenHorizontalLines
properties.description: Returns or sets the interval at which Microsoft Word displays horizontal character gridlines in print layout view. Read/write Long.

properties.name: GridSpaceBetweenVerticalLines
properties.description: Returns or sets the interval at which Microsoft Word displays vertical character gridlines in print layout view. Read/write Long.

properties.name: GridOriginFromMargin
properties.description: True if Microsoft Word starts the character grid from the upper-left corner of the page. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: KerningByAlgorithm
properties.description: True if Microsoft Word kerns half-width Latin characters and punctuation marks in the specified document. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: JustificationMode
properties.description: Returns or sets the character spacing adjustment for the specified document. Read/write WdJustificationMode.

properties.name: FarEastLineBreakLevel
properties.description: Returns or sets a WdFarEastLineBreakLevel that represents the line break control level for the specified document. Read/write.

properties.name: NoLineBreakBefore
properties.description: Returns or sets the kinsoku characters before which Microsoft Word will not break a line. Read/write String.

properties.name: NoLineBreakAfter
properties.description: Returns or sets the kinsoku characters after which Microsoft Word will not break a line. Read/write String.

properties.name: TrackRevisions
properties.description: True if changes are tracked in the specified document. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: PrintRevisions
properties.description: True if revision marks are printed with the document. False if revision marks aren't printed (that is, tracked changes are printed as if they'd been accepted). Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ActiveTheme
properties.description: Returns the name of the active theme plus the theme formatting options for the specified document. Read-only String.

properties.name: ActiveThemeDisplayName
properties.description: Returns the display name of the active theme for the specified document. Read-only String.

properties.name: Email
properties.description: Returns an Email object that contains all the email-related properties of the current document. Read-only.

properties.name: Scripts
properties.description: Returns a Scripts collection that represents the collection of HTML scripts in the specified object.

properties.name: LanguageDetected
properties.description: Returns or sets a value that specifies whether Microsoft Word has detected the language of the specified text. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: FarEastLineBreakLanguage
properties.description: Returns or sets a WdFarEastLineBreakLanguageID that represents the East Asian language to use when breaking lines of text in the specified document or template. Read/write.

properties.name: Frameset
properties.description: Returns a Frameset object that represents an entire frames page or a single frame on a frames page. Read-only.

properties.name: ClickAndTypeParagraphStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets the default paragraph style applied to text by the Click and Type feature in the specified document. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: WebOptions
properties.description: Returns the WebOptions object, which contains document-level attributes used by Microsoft Word when you save a document as a webpage or open a webpage. Read-only.

properties.name: OpenEncoding
properties.description: Returns the encoding used to open the specified document. Read-only MsoEncoding.

properties.name: SaveEncoding
properties.description: Returns or sets the encoding to use when saving a document. Read/write MsoEncoding.

properties.name: OptimizeForWord97
properties.description: True if Microsoft Word optimizes the current document for viewing in Microsoft Word 97 by disabling any incompatible formatting. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: VBASigned
properties.description: True if the Microsoft Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) project for the specified document has been digitally signed. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: MailEnvelope
properties.description: Returns an MsoEnvelope object that represents an email header for a document.

properties.name: DisableFeatures
properties.description: True disables all features introduced after the version specified in the DisableFeaturesIntroducedAfter property. The default value is False. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DoNotEmbedSystemFonts
properties.description: True for Microsoft Word to not embed common system fonts. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Signatures
properties.description: Returns a SignatureSet collection that represents the digital signatures for a document.

properties.name: DefaultTargetFrame
properties.description: Returns or sets a String indicating the browser frame in which to display a webpage reached through a hyperlink. Read/write.

properties.name: HTMLDivisions
properties.description: Returns an HTMLDivisions collection that represents the HTML DIV elements in a web document.

properties.name: DisableFeaturesIntroducedAfter
properties.description: Disables all features introduced after a specified version of Microsoft Word in the document only. Read/write WdDisableFeaturesIntroducedAfter.

properties.name: RemovePersonalInformation
properties.description: True if Microsoft Word removes all user information from comments, revisions, and the Properties dialog box upon saving a document. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: TextEncoding
properties.description: Returns or sets the code page, or character set, that Microsoft Word uses for a document saved as an encoded text file. Read/write MsoEncoding.

properties.name: TextLineEnding
properties.description: Returns or sets a WdLineEndingType constant indicating how Microsoft Word marks the line and paragraph breaks in documents saved as text files. Read/write.

properties.name: StyleSheets
properties.description: Returns a StyleSheets collection that represents the Web style sheets attached to a document.

properties.name: DefaultTableStyle
properties.description: Returns a Variant that represents the table style that is applied to all newly created tables in a document. Read-only.

properties.name: PasswordEncryptionProvider
properties.description: Returns a String specifying the name of the algorithm encryption provider that Microsoft Word uses when encrypting documents with passwords. Read-only.

properties.name: PasswordEncryptionAlgorithm
properties.description: Returns a String indicating the algorithm Microsoft Word uses for encrypting documents with passwords. Read-only.

properties.name: PasswordEncryptionKeyLength
properties.description: Returns a Long indicating the key length of the algorithm Microsoft Word uses when encrypting documents with passwords. Read-only.

properties.name: PasswordEncryptionFileProperties
properties.description: True if Microsoft Word encrypts file properties for password-protected documents. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: EmbedLinguisticData
properties.description: True for Microsoft Word to embed speech and handwriting so that data can be converted back to speech or handwriting. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: FormattingShowFont
properties.description: True for Microsoft Word to display font formatting in the Styles and Formatting task pane. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: FormattingShowClear
properties.description: True for Microsoft Word to show clear formatting in the Styles and Formatting task pane. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: FormattingShowParagraph
properties.description: True for Microsoft Word to display paragraph formatting in the Styles and Formatting task pane. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: FormattingShowNumbering
properties.description: True for Microsoft Word to display number formatting in the Styles and Formatting task pane. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: FormattingShowFilter
properties.description: Sets or returns a WdShowFilter constant that represents the styles and formatting displayed in the Styles and Formatting task pane. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Permission
properties.description: Returns a Permission object that represents the permission settings in the specified document.

properties.name: XMLSchemaReferences
properties.description: Returns an XMLSchemaReferences collection that represents the schemas attached to a document.

properties.name: SmartDocument
properties.description: Returns a SmartDocument object that represents the settings for a smart document solution.

properties.name: EnforceStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether formatting restrictions are enforced in a protected document.

properties.name: AutoFormatOverride
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether automatic formatting options override formatting restrictions in a document where formatting restrictions are in effect.

properties.name: XMLShowAdvancedErrors
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether error message text is generated from the built-in Microsoft Word error messages or from the Microsoft XML Core Services (MSXML) 5.0 component included with Office.

properties.name: XMLUseXSLTWhenSaving
properties.description: Returns a Boolean that represents whether to save a document through an Extensible Stylesheet Language Transformation (XSLT). True saves a document through an XSLT.

properties.name: XMLSaveThroughXSLT
properties.description: Sets or returns a String that specifies the path and file name for the Extensible Stylesheet Language Transformation (XSLT) to apply when a user saves a document.

properties.name: DocumentLibraryVersions
properties.description: Returns a DocumentLibraryVersions collection that represents the collection of versions of a shared document that has versioning enabled and that is stored in a document library on a server.

properties.name: ReadingModeLayoutFrozen
properties.description: Sets or returns a Boolean that represents whether pages displayed in reading layout view are frozen to a specified size for inserting handwritten markup into a document.

properties.name: RemoveDateAndTime
properties.description: Sets or returns a Boolean indicating whether a document stores the date and time metadata for tracked changes. .

properties.name: ReadingLayoutSizeX
properties.description: Sets or returns a Long that represents the width of pages in a document when it is displayed in reading layout view and is frozen for entering handwritten markup.

properties.name: ReadingLayoutSizeY
properties.description: Sets or returns a Long that represents the height of pages in a document when it is displayed in reading layout view and is frozen for entering handwritten markup.

properties.name: StyleSortMethod
properties.description: Returns or sets a WdStyleSort constant that represents the sort method to use when sorting styles in the Styles task pane. Read/write.

properties.name: ContentTypeProperties
properties.description: Returns a MetaProperties collection that represents the metadata stored in a document, such as author name, subject, and company. Read-only.

properties.name: TrackMoves
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether to mark moved text when Track Changes is turned on. Read/write.

properties.name: TrackFormatting
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether to track formatting changes when change tracking is turned on. Read/write.

properties.name: OMaths
properties.description: Returns an OMaths collection that represents the OMath objects within the specified range. Read-only.

properties.name: ServerPolicy
properties.description: Returns a ServerPolicy object that represents a policy specified for a document stored on a server running Microsoft Office SharePoint Server 2007. Read-only.

properties.name: ContentControls
properties.description: Returns a ContentControls collection that represents all the content controls in a document. Read-only.

properties.name: DocumentInspectors
properties.description: Returns a DocumentInspectors collection that enables you to locate hidden personal information, such as author name, company name, and revision date. Read-only.

properties.name: Bibliography
properties.description: Returns a Bibliography object that represents the bibliography references contained within a document. Read-only.

properties.name: LockTheme
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether a user can change a document theme. Read/write.

properties.name: LockQuickStyleSet
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether users can change which set of Quick Styles is being used. Read/write.

properties.name: OriginalDocumentTitle
properties.description: Returns a String that represents the document title for the original document after running a legal-blackline document compare function. Read-only.

properties.name: RevisedDocumentTitle
properties.description: Returns a String that represents the document title for a revised document after running a legal-blackline document compare function. Read-only.

properties.name: CustomXMLParts
properties.description: Returns a CustomXMLParts collection that represents the custom XML in the XML data store. Read-only.

properties.name: FormattingShowNextLevel
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether Microsoft Word shows the next heading level when the previous heading level is used. Read/write.

properties.name: FormattingShowUserStyleName
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether to show user-defined styles. Read/write.

properties.name: Research
properties.description: Returns a Research object that represents the research service for a document. Read-only.

properties.name: Final
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that indicates whether a document is final. Read/write.

properties.name: OMathBreakBin
properties.description: Returns or sets a WdOMathBreakBin constant that represents where Microsoft Word places binary operators when equations span two or more lines. Read/write.

properties.name: OMathBreakSub
properties.description: Returns or sets a WdOMathBreakSub constant that represents how Microsoft Word handles a subtraction operator that falls before a line break. Read/write.

properties.name: OMathJc
properties.description: Returns or sets a WdOMathJc constant that represents the default justification-left, right, centered, or centered as a group-of a group of equations. Read/write.

properties.name: OMathLeftMargin
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the left margin for equations. Read/write.

properties.name: OMathRightMargin
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the right margin for equations. Read/write.

properties.name: OMathWrap
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the placement of the second line of an equation that wraps to a new line. Read/write.

properties.name: OMathIntSubSupLim
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents the default location of limits for integrals. Read/write.

properties.name: OMathNarySupSubLim
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents the default location of limits for n-ary objects other than integrals. Read/write.

properties.name: OMathSmallFrac
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether to use small fractions in equations contained within the document. Read/write.

properties.name: WordOpenXML
properties.description: Returns a String that represents the flat XML format for the Word Open XML contents of the document. Read-only.

properties.name: DocumentTheme
properties.description: Returns an OfficeTheme object that represents the Microsoft Office theme applied to a document. Read-only.

properties.name: HasVBProject
properties.description: Returns a Boolean that represents whether a document has an attached Microsoft Visual Basic for Applications project. Read-only.

properties.name: OMathFontName
properties.description: Returns or sets a String that represents the name of the font used in a document to display equations. Read/write.

properties.name: EncryptionProvider
properties.description: Returns a String specifying the name of the algorithm encryption provider that Microsoft Word uses when encrypting documents. Read/write.

properties.name: UseMathDefaults
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether to use the default math settings when creating new equations. Read/write.

properties.name: CurrentRsid
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents a random number that Word assigns to changes in a document. Read-only.

properties.name: CompatibilityMode
properties.description: Returns a Long that specifies the compatibility mode that Word uses when opening the document. Read-only.

properties.name: CoAuthoring
properties.description: Returns a CoAuthoring object that provides the entry point into the co authoring object model. Read-only.

properties.name: Broadcast
properties.description: Returns a Broadcast object that represents a broadcast session, in which presenters can present Word documents to remote participants over the web without the participants needing to have rich clients installed.

properties.name: ChartDataPointTrack
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that specifies whether charts in the active document use cell-reference data-point tracking. Read/write.

properties.name: IsInAutosave
properties.description: Returns False if the most recent firing of the Application.DocumentBeforeSave event (Word) event was the result of a manual save by the user, and not an automatic save. Read-only.

properties.name: AutoSaveOn
properties.description: True if the edits in the document are automatically saved. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: SensitivityLabel
properties.description: Returns the Microsoft Office SensitivityLabel object from the Document.

methods.name: Close
methods.signature: Close([SaveChanges As Variant], [OriginalFormat As Variant], [RouteDocument As Variant])
methods.description: Closes the specified document.

parameters.name: SaveChanges
parameters.description: Specifies the save action for the document. Can be one of the following WdSaveOptions constants: wdDoNotSaveChanges, wdPromptToSaveChanges, or wdSaveChanges.

parameters.name: OriginalFormat
parameters.description: Specifies the save format for the document. Can be one of the following WdOriginalFormat constants: wdOriginalDocumentFormat, wdPromptUser, or wdWordDocument.

parameters.name: RouteDocument
parameters.description: True to route the document to the next recipient. If the document does not have a routing slip attached, this argument is ignored.

methods.name: Repaginate
methods.description: Repaginates the entire document.

methods.name: FitToPages
methods.description: Decreases the font size of text just enough so that the document will fit on one fewer pages.

methods.name: ManualHyphenation
methods.description: Initiates manual hyphenation of a document, one line at a time.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: Selects the contents of the specified document.

methods.name: DataForm
methods.description: Displays the Data Form dialog box, in which you can add, delete, or modify records.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves the specified document.

methods.name: SendMail
methods.description: Opens a message window for sending the specified document through Microsoft Exchange.

methods.name: Range
methods.signature: Range([Start As Variant], [End As Variant]) As Range
methods.description: Returns a Range object by using the specified starting and ending character positions.

parameters.name: Start
parameters.description: The starting character position.

parameters.name: End
parameters.description: The ending character position.

methods.name: RunAutoMacro
methods.description: Runs an auto macro that's stored in the specified document. If the specified auto macro doesn't exist, nothing happens.

parameters.name: Which
parameters.description: The auto macro to run.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates the specified document so that it becomes the active document.

methods.name: PrintPreview
methods.description: Switches the view to print preview.

methods.name: GoTo
methods.signature: GoTo([What As Variant], [Which As Variant], [Count As Variant], [Name As Variant]) As Range
methods.description: Returns a Range object that represents the start position of the specified item, such as a page, bookmark, or field.

parameters.name: What
parameters.description: The kind of item to which the range or selection is moved. Can be one of the WdGoToItem constants.

parameters.name: Which

methods.name: ExportAsFixedFormat
methods.signature: ExportAsFixedFormat(OutputFileName As String, ExportFormat As WdExportFormat, [OpenAfterExport As Boolean], [OptimizeFor As WdExportOptimizeFor], [Range As WdExportRange], [From As Long], [To As Long], [Item As WdExportItem], [IncludeDocProps As Boolean], [KeepIRM As Boolean], [CreateBookmarks As WdExportCreateBookmarks], [DocStructureTags As Boolean], [BitmapMissingFonts As Boolean], [UseISO19005_1 As Boolean], [FixedFormatExtClassPtr As Variant])
methods.description: Saves a document in PDF or XPS format.

parameters.name: OutputFileName
parameters.description: The path and file name of the new PDF or XPS file.

parameters.name: ExportFormat
parameters.description: Specifies either PDF or XPS format.

parameters.name: OpenAfterExport
parameters.description: Opens the new file after exporting the contents.

parameters.name: OptimizeFor
parameters.description: Specifies whether to optimize for screen or print.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: Specifies whether the export range is the entire document, the current page, a range of text, or the current selection. The default is to export the entire document.

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: Specifies the starting page number, if the _Range_ parameter is set to wdExportFromTo.

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: Specifies the ending page number, if the _Range_ parameter is set to wdExportFromTo.

parameters.name: Item
parameters.description: Specifies whether the export process includes text only or includes text with markup.

parameters.name: IncludeDocProps
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include document properties in the newly exported file.

parameters.name: KeepIRM
parameters.description: Specifies whether to copy IRM permissions to an XPS document if the source document has IRM protections.</br></br>If _ExportFormat_ is _wdExportFormatPDF_, this flag also specifies whether to copy labels to the PDF.</br></br>Default value is True.

parameters.name: CreateBookmarks
parameters.description: Specifies whether to export bookmarks and the type of bookmarks to export.

parameters.name: DocStructureTags
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include extra data to help screen readers, for example information about the flow and logical organization of the content. Default value is True.

parameters.name: BitmapMissingFonts
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include a bitmap of the text. Set this parameter to True when font licenses don't permit a font to be embedded in the PDF file. If False, the font is referenced, and the viewer's computer substitutes an appropriate font if the authored one is not available. Default value is True.

parameters.name: FixedFormatExtClassPtr
parameters.description: Specifies a pointer to an add-in that allows calls to an alternate implementation of code. The alternate implementation of code interprets the EMF and EMF+ page descriptions that are generated by the applications to make their own PDF or XPS. For more information, see Extend the fixed-format export feature in Word Automation Services.

methods.name: FreezeLayout
methods.description: In Web view, fixes the layout of the document as it currently appears so that line breaks remain fixed and ink annotations don't move when you resize the window.

methods.name: DowngradeDocument
methods.description: Downgrades a document to the Word 97-2003 document format so that it can be edited in a previous version of Microsoft Word. .

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts file to the newest file format and enables all new features.

methods.name: SelectContentControlsByTag
methods.description: Returns a ContentControls collection that represents all the content controls in a document with the tag value specified in the Tag parameter. Read-only.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tag value of the content controls to return.

methods.name: ConvertAutoHyphens
methods.description: Converts hyphens created by automatic hyphenation to manual hyphens.

methods.name: ApplyQuickStyleSet2
methods.description: Applies the specified Quick Style set to the document.

parameters.name: Style
parameters.description: Can be either a String that specifies the name of the set to use (corresponds to the name listed in the Style Set list) or a constant from the WdApplyQuickStyleSets enumeration.

methods.name: SaveAs2
methods.signature: SaveAs2([FileName As Variant], [FileFormat As Variant], [LockComments As Variant], [Password As Variant], [AddToRecentFiles As Variant], [WritePassword As Variant], [ReadOnlyRecommended As Variant], [EmbedTrueTypeFonts As Variant], [SaveNativePictureFormat As Variant], [SaveFormsData As Variant], [SaveAsAOCELetter As Variant], [Encoding As Variant], [InsertLineBreaks As Variant], [AllowSubstitutions As Variant], [LineEnding As Variant], [AddBiDiMarks As Variant], [CompatibilityMode As Variant])

methods.name: ReturnToLastReadPosition
methods.description: Returns the active document to the last saved reading position, and returns an integer that represents that position.

events.name: New
events.description: Occurs when a new document based on the template is created. A procedure for the New event will run only if it is stored in a template.

events.name: Open
events.description: Occurs when a document is opened.

events.name: Close
events.description: Occurs when a document is closed.

parameters.name: SyncEventType
parameters.description: The status of the document synchronization.

events.name: XMLAfterInsert
events.signature: XMLAfterInsert(NewXMLNode As XMLNode, InUndoRedo As Boolean)
events.description: Occurs when a user adds a new XML element to a document. If more than one element is added to the document at the same time (for example, when cutting and pasting XML), the event fires for each element that is inserted.

parameters.name: NewXMLNode
parameters.description: The newly added XML node.

parameters.name: InUndoRedo
parameters.description: True indicates the action was performed using the Undo or Redo feature in Microsoft Word.

events.name: XMLBeforeDelete
events.signature: XMLBeforeDelete(DeletedRange As Range, OldXMLNode As XMLNode, InUndoRedo As Boolean)
events.description: Occurs when a user deletes an XML element from a document. If more than one element is deleted from the document at the same time (for example, when cutting and pasting XML), the event fires for each element that is deleted.

parameters.name: DeletedRange
parameters.description: The contents of the XML element being deleted. If only an element is deleted and not associated text, the DeletedRange parameter will not exist and will, therefore, be set to Nothing.

parameters.name: OldXMLNode
parameters.description: The node that is being deleted.

parameters.name: InUndoRedo
parameters.description: True indicates the action was performed using the Undo or Redo feature in Microsoft Word.

events.name: ContentControlAfterAdd
events.signature: ContentControlAfterAdd(NewContentControl As ContentControl, InUndoRedo As Boolean)
events.description: Occurs after adding a content control to a document.

parameters.name: NewContentControl
parameters.description: The content control being added.

parameters.name: InUndoRedo
parameters.description: Specifies whether the addition is taking place as part an undo or redo action.

events.name: ContentControlBeforeDelete
events.description: Occurs before removing a content control from a document.

parameters.name: OldContentControl
parameters.description: The content control being deleted.

parameters.name: InUndoRedo
parameters.description: Specifies whether the removal is taking place as part an undo or redo action.

events.name: ContentControlOnExit
events.signature: ContentControlOnExit(ContentControl As ContentControl, Cancel As Boolean)
events.description: Occurs when a user leaves a content control.

parameters.name: ContentControl
parameters.description: The content control that the user is leaving.

parameters.name: Cancel
parameters.description: Specifies whether to cancel the event. True cancels the event and does not allow the user to leave the control.

events.name: ContentControlOnEnter
events.description: Occurs when a user enters a content control.

parameters.name: ContentControl
parameters.description: The content control that the user is entering.

events.name: ContentControlBeforeStoreUpdate
events.description: Occurs before updating the document's XML data store with the value of a content control.

parameters.name: ContentControl
parameters.description: The content control being updated.

parameters.name: Content
parameters.description: The content being stored for a control in the document data store. Use this parameter to change the XML data before sending the value to the XML data store.

events.name: ContentControlBeforeContentUpdate
events.description: Occurs before updating the content in a content control, but only when the content comes from the Office XML data store.

parameters.name: ContentControl
parameters.description: The content control being updated.

parameters.name: Content
parameters.description: The updated content for a control. Use this parameter to change the contents of the XML data and format it for display.

events.name: BuildingBlockInsert
events.signature: BuildingBlockInsert(Range As Range, Name As String, Category As String, BlockType As String, Template As String)
events.description: Occurs when you insert a building block into a document. .

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: Specifies the position where the building block is inserted.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Specifies the name of the building block.

parameters.name: Category
parameters.description: Specifies the building block category.

parameters.name: Template
parameters.description: Specifies the name of the template that contains the building block.
